content:
ashley: Heads-up — I'm going to change how the payment service gets AWS creds. Moving from the IRSA annotation approach to using projected serviceAccount tokens (k8s projected-token flow) in terraform. PR up for a quick look?

ashley: Terraform snippet I'm proposing:
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "payment_sa" {
  name = "redwood-payment-sa"
  # assume role policy...
}

resource "kubernetes_service_account" "payment_sa" {
  metadata {
    name = "payment-svc"
    namespace = "payment"
    annotations = {
      # old: "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.payment_sa.arn
      # new: remove IRSA annotation, rely on projected token + token review webhook
    }
  }
  automount_service_account_token = true
}
```

ashley: Plan shows role created + serviceaccount patch. Doing a canary in staging first.

sanjay: Quick q: are we removing the `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` annotation entirely? IRSA requires it to map pods to role. How will the projection trigger AWS SDK to assume role?

ashley: Good Q. We're switching to the new workflow where the kubelet projects a bound token that the service calls STS:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity against the cluster OIDC provider. In practice we still need an IAM role and trust for the serviceaccount, but instead of long-lived annotation at deploy time we're opting for projected-token + TokenRequest API, and setting the IAM trust relationship to accept the serviceaccount subject. The difference is avoiding patch-heavy workflow in k8s manifests and leaning on token projection.

maria: Can you paste the PR link? I want to check the role's trust policy and that the OIDC provider exists in aws. Also confirm k8s version for TokenRequest support (should be >=1.20).

ashley: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/642
Plan snippet: 
```
 +/- resource aws_iam_role.payment_sa
 +/- resource kubernetes_service_account.payment_sa
```
CI: deploy-bot: CI checks passed.

deploy-bot: Automated CI: terraform fmt/static-checks ✅, plan ✅

sanjay: Sounds okay. Migration notes: 1) create IAM role with trust for `system:serviceaccount:payment:payment-svc` 2) deploy role first, 3) patch SA to set `automountServiceAccountToken=true` and remove IRSA annotation in a controlled window, 4) verify JWT token can be exchanged (use `kubectl create token payment-svc -n payment`) 5) test app can call STS:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.

ashley: I'll add those steps to the PR description. Also will do a 1-pod canary in staging for 30m.

maria: Also watch for any webhook/admission controllers that rely on the annotation (we had a custom mutating webhook that auto-injects secrets for old flow). Update webhook config if needed.

ashley: Good catch — the mutating webhook in `infra` expects `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`. I'll add a fallback in the webhook to detect the new annotation-less flow.

ops-oncall: Rollout window? I'd prefer < 1h during low traffic, and monitor auth errors. Set alert for high `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` failures or 401 from AWS SDK.

ashley: Will schedule 00:30–01:30 UTC tomorrow. I will create a temporary alert on datadog for `aws.sts.assume_role_with_web_identity.errors` and `k8s.serviceaccount.token_request.failures`.

sanjay: One more: if anything breaks, can we revert by re-applying the old annotation? Keep the Terraform code such that the annotation change is a separate commit/PR so revert is trivial.

ashley: Yep, annotation removal is isolated to one TF resource change. Revert plan is just reapply old serviceaccount metadata.

maria: lgtm on the approach. Please include the validation commands in PR:
```
kubectl -n payment create token payment-svc --duration=1h
# then locally: aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn <role> --role-session-name tmp --web-identity-token file://token.txt
```

ashley: Added validation steps and webhook fallback in PR. Will merge after staging canary is clean. Thanks 🙏 :shipit:

deploy-bot: Deployment to staging triggered by merge — tag: staging-canary-1805 ✅

ashley: Staging canary healthy after 20m. No auth errors observed. Will proceed to prod canary tomorrow in that window.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll be on standby.

maria: Thanks — keep me posted if you need rollback help.

ashley: Will do. End of thread.
